stories.title: Pakistan Urges Swift US-Iran Deal Amid Global Economic Strain
stories.summary:
Pakistan's Deputy Prime Minister Ishaq Dar expressed optimism for a swift agreement between the United States and Iran, warning that the world cannot endure a prolonged Middle East conflict. Speaking in an interview broadcast on Saturday, Dar highlighted supply chain disruptions, price hikes, and widespread suffering globally and within Pakistan as reasons for urgency. He reiterated Islamabad's commitment to independent multilateral diplomacy and its ongoing mediation efforts.

Dar detailed Pakistan's diplomatic involvement, noting that it was the first nation to condemn an Israeli strike on February 28. Following regional escalation, Islamabad hosted the first direct, face-to-face talks between Washington and Tehran in 47 years on April 10 and 11. These efforts culminated in the June 18 Islamabad Memorandum of Understanding, signed remotely by US President Donald Trump and the Iranian president. Dar also mentioned a five-point peace initiative formulated during a March visit to China and ongoing cooperation through regional diplomatic groups.

Addressing other foreign policy matters, Dar discussed relations with Beijing and Washington, noting Pakistan's parallel strategic partnerships. On Afghanistan, he stated that while Islamabad provided swift humanitarian and economic assistance, its demand to halt the use of Afghan soil for terrorism remains unmet. He cited credible evidence linking terrorist attacks in October to groups operating from Afghanistan.

Turning to India, Dar said bilateral talks depend on New Delhi, criticizing unconstitutional changes in Jammu and Kashmir and India's decision to place the 1960 Indus Waters Treaty in abeyance. He emphasized that water supplies are critical for Pakistan's 260 million people and that international treaties must be respected. Domestically, he noted Pakistan's $130 billion external debt and ongoing counter-terrorism economic burdens.

stories.title: Pakistan Government Cuts Prices for Kerosene, Jet Fuel, and LDO
stories.summary:
The Pakistani government announced reductions in the prices of kerosene oil, jet fuel, and light diesel oil (LDO), taking effect nationwide on November 21. According to Pakistan State Oil (PSO), jet fuel prices dropped by Rs12.06 to Rs287.71 per litre from Rs299.77. Kerosene oil decreased by Rs10.42 to Rs273.22 per litre from Rs283.64, while light diesel oil fell by Rs11.44 to Rs220.28 per litre from its previous rate of Rs231.72.

This adjustment follows earlier federal revisions where the price of petrol was reduced by Rs1 per litre to Rs322, while high-speed diesel increased by Rs2 per litre to cost Rs357. Earlier in the year, fuel costs experienced sharp fluctuations, including a significant reduction in May after jet fuel rates had surged by 82% in March. Those earlier hikes had also prompted Pakistan Railways to adjust passenger and freight fares.

The recent fuel price adjustments coincide with broader economic pressures stemming from Middle East tensions involving the United States, Israel, and Iran. Escalating Gulf conflict has driven global oil prices upward and raised concerns over potential disruptions to vital energy shipping routes through the Strait of Hormuz, directly impacting fuel-importing nations like Pakistan.

stories.title: Pakistan Maritime Minister Calls for High-Value Seafood Export Growth
stories.summary:
Federal Minister for Maritime Affairs Muhammad Junaid Anwar Chaudhry has advocated for transforming Pakistan's fisheries sector into a high-value export industry. Marking World Fisheries Day on November 21, Chaudhry emphasized the necessity of securing sustainable marine resources, decent employment, and improved livelihoods for fishing communities across the country.

Chaudhry reported that Pakistan produced 642,180 metric tonnes of fish between July and March of the 2025-26 financial year, comprising 427,180 tonnes from marine fisheries and 215,000 tonnes from inland waters. Seafood exports brought in $568 million during the same period, demonstrating the sector's substantial contribution to foreign exchange earnings and economic growth.

To fully realize the industry's potential, the minister stressed the need for modern fishing methods, upgraded infrastructure, stronger regulations, and increased processing investments. Aligned with World Fisheries Day themes, he called for enhanced workplace safety, technical training, and expanded opportunities for women and youth in aquaculture and seafood marketing.

Furthermore, Chaudhry highlighted the importance of strengthening the entire seafood value chain, ensuring compliance with international food safety and sustainability standards, and applying science-based fisheries management. He stated that these measures are vital to protect marine biodiversity, diversify export destinations, and reinforce Pakistan's Blue Economy.

stories.title: Grand Theft Auto VI Surpasses Expectations with Record Sales and Launch
stories.summary:
Rockstar Games' newly released title "Grand Theft Auto VI" has exceeded monumental expectations, achieving record retail sales of $3.79 billion globally by the end of launch day. Following a 13-year wait and a $1 billion production budget, the game earned near-universal acclaim, securing a Metacritic score of 99 out of 100. Industry peers, including CD Projekt Red and Pocketpair, praised the achievement, which provided a major boost for Take-Two Interactive, Sony, and Microsoft.

Market intelligence firm Sensor Tower reported that approximately three-quarters of launch sales occurred on the PlayStation 5, with the remainder on Xbox Series X or S, ahead of a planned PC release next year. Set in Leonida—a fictionalized version of Florida—the game features dual protagonists, Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos, marking the franchise's first fully developed female lead. This inclusion reflects shifting demographics, with women projected to comprise 40% of US players.

The game's unprecedented level of detail allows players to engage in diverse activities alongside traditional criminal pursuits, winning praise for its immersive open world. While some critics on social media questioned the inclusive direction and narrative options, the title's commercial success highlights the cultural and artistic evolution of video games since the franchise's origins in Dundee, Scotland, during the 1990s.

stories.title: Climate change poses grave threat to civilizations, warns Musadik Malik
stories.summary:
Federal Minister for Climate Change and Environmental Coordination Dr. Musadik Malik warned at the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation Civilisational Dialogue Forum in New Delhi that global climate change threatens human civilizations and cultural heritage. Malik noted that extreme weather events present a major danger to historical sites, pointing specifically to the severe 2022 floods in Pakistan that claimed around 1,700 lives, submerged one-third of the country, and damaged the ancient 4,500-year-old walls of Mohenjo-Daro over four days of rain. He also referenced recent flooding in Nepal to emphasize South Asia's vulnerability to extreme climate patterns.

During his address, the minister acknowledged that human activities are driving the environmental crisis. He highlighted the rich historical and cultural diversity of Pakistan, comparing it to a colorful bouquet where different communities contribute their unique languages, identities, and traditions. He argued that cultural heritage cannot be viewed through a single perspective and that meaningful societal dialogue relies on diverse voices rather than uniformity.

Opting to speak in Urdu instead of English at the beginning of his remarks, Malik explained that he felt a personal connection to the language due to his proximity to the tombs of Sufi saint Nizamuddin Auliya and Urdu poet Mirza Ghalib in Delhi. He emphasized that the forum served as an important platform to celebrate cultural variety and foster constructive dialogue among different civilizations across the region.

The address underscored the growing urgency of addressing environmental degradation as a cultural and civilizational crisis. By connecting climate vulnerability directly to the preservation of shared human history, Malik called attention to the profound stakes involved in failing to tackle global ecological challenges, particularly for developing nations in South Asia that face recurrent natural disasters.

stories.title: Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi and JI Chief Hafiz Naeemur Rehman Meet in Lahore
stories.summary:
Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi met with Jamaat-i-Islami (JI) chief Hafiz Naeemur Rehman in Lahore to discuss the country's overall situation, public challenges, and local law and order measures. The interior ministry stated that both leaders agreed to maintain ongoing consultations to address pressing national issues, with Naqvi emphasizing that everyone must play an effective role in overcoming these difficulties.

During the meeting, the JI chief stressed that providing immediate relief to ordinary citizens must remain the government's primary focus. Rehman pointed out that citizens are severely burdened by poverty, inflation, and soaring economic hardships, noting that continuous spikes in essential commodities such as flour, sugar, cooking oil, and pulses have made daily life extremely difficult. Official data from the Pakistan Bureau of Statistics indicated that weekly inflation reached 10.41 percent year-on-year by November 19, driven heavily by rising wheat flour prices.

Rehman also drew attention to exorbitant electricity and gas bills that disproportionately burden middle- and lower-income families, making basic necessities, healthcare, and education increasingly unaffordable for the working class. While acknowledging a slight relief through reduced petrol prices, Rehman reiterated the JI's demand for the complete abolition of petroleum levies, citing months of advocacy against high fuel costs linked to Middle East conflicts. He urged the government to penalize hoarders and profiteers while shifting financial burdens away from the public and toward the privileged class.

Discussions between the government and JI have been ongoing, with both sides recently completing technical-level committee negotiations to finalize draft proposals regarding public relief measures. These talks follow previous engagements, including an October meeting between Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif and Rehman where they agreed to explore expanding fuel relief schemes and reducing petroleum levies.

stories.title: FIA Arrests Two Suspects in Rs. 250 Million Immigration Fraud Case
stories.summary:
The Federal Investigation Agency (FIA) successfully apprehended two suspects linked to a massive immigration fraud valued at approximately Rs. 250 million. The arrests were executed by the FIA’s Anti-Human Trafficking Circle operating within the federal capital of Islamabad.

According to federal investigators, the detained individuals operated as part of an organized syndicate that targeted citizens by falsely promising employment and immigration opportunities in Saudi Arabia. Authorities identified the primary suspect and alleged mastermind behind the network as Jahanzeb Akram, also known by the alias Junaid Butt.

The operation highlights ongoing efforts by law enforcement agencies to crack down on fraudulent human trafficking rings that exploit job seekers. The scam left numerous victims defrauded of large sums of money under the guise of securing overseas jobs.

Meanwhile, in a separate development, Federal Minister for Maritime Affairs Muhammad Junaid Anwar Chaudhry released a statement on World Fisheries Day emphasizing the need to develop Pakistan's fisheries sector into a high-value export industry while ensuring sustainable marine resource management and better livelihoods for local fishing communities.

stories.title: UK Maritime Agency Reports Two Tanker Attacks Near Oman and Strait of Hormuz
stories.summary:
The United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations (UKMTO) reported that two separate tanker incidents occurred near Oman and the strategic Strait of Hormuz. In the first event, an outbound tanker was struck on its stern by an unidentified projectile approximately 11 nautical miles north of Khasab, Oman. Shortly afterward, UKMTO received a second report indicating that a tanker had sustained engine room damage from an unidentified projectile located 17 nautical miles east of Khasab. Officials noted it remained unclear whether both reports involved the same vessel, though no casualties were reported and the environmental impact was initially unknown.

Concurrently, the Iranian navy reported that an oil tanker caught fire after striking a naval mine within a restricted zone east of the Strait of Hormuz. Reuters could not independently verify the Iranian account or confirm its connection to the incidents documented by UKMTO. These events followed a previous attack on a tanker near Khasab that sparked an onboard fire, as noted by British maritime security sources.

Tensions in the region remain elevated as Tehran continues to enforce strict passage regulations through the Strait of Hormuz, targeting vessels it accuses of violating these rules in an effort to assert dominance over the waterway and apply pressure on Washington. The Strait of Hormuz historically served as a vital maritime corridor, carrying nearly one-fifth of global crude oil supplies before the onset of the Iran conflict.

stories.title: Police Recover Three Bodies from Graves in Balochistan and Arrest Suspect
stories.summary: Law enforcement authorities in Balochistan successfully recovered the bodies of three individuals buried within the Haji Kot area situated in the Barkhan district. Alongside the grim discovery, authorities managed to take the prime suspect into custody regarding the ongoing investigation. Officials stated that the unearthing of the remains occurred following critical intelligence provided by the detained suspect. The initial legal case was officially registered after a formal complaint was lodged by a man named Pyara Khan, who directed his accusations toward former provincial minister Sardar Abdul Rehman Khetran. Significantly, one of the deceased victims was found buried in close proximity to the residential property belonging to the former provincial official. Following their recovery, the remains were transported to a medical facility to undergo thorough post-mortem examinations and to facilitate subsequent legal measures. Meanwhile, official sources indicated that Khetran had previously attempted to depart from Pakistan via the Lahore airport but was blocked from leaving because his personal details were actively listed on the stop list. In a separate medical development, the Sindh Institute of Cardiovascular Diseases reported providing complimentary emergency medical care to 22,639 heart attack patients across the Sindh province during the initial ten months of the current year. Furthermore, a total of 1,626 patients successfully underwent free open-heart surgeries within the exact same timeframe, utilizing thirty specialized Chest Pain Units established throughout the region to deliver vital medical assistance to those in urgent need of cardiac intervention.

stories.title: Gold Prices Decline Across Pakistan Following Drops in International Markets
stories.summary: The domestic cost of gold experienced a downward adjustment across Pakistan, moving in tandem with concurrent losses recorded within the global bullion market. According to official pricing figures released by the All-Pakistan Gems and Jewellers Sarafa Association, the local market rate for gold per tola fell by Rs3,500 during the trading day, bringing the overall price down to Rs376,336. In a similar fashion, the price for 10 grams of gold registered a decrease of Rs3,001, resulting in a selling price of Rs322,647. This latest domestic markdown follows a previous trading session on Friday, during which the per tola gold price had reached Rs379,836 after suffering a substantial loss of Rs15,400 over the course of that day. On the international stage, the global price of gold experienced a contraction of $35, ultimately settling at a rate of $3,538 per ounce. In addition to the fluctuations observed in precious yellow metal markets, the local valuation for silver also encountered a downward shift, dropping by Rs108 to reach a new price level of Rs4,600 per tola. Market observers continue to monitor these shifts closely as local jewelers adjust their daily rate sheets to reflect ongoing international economic trends and currency valuations.

stories.title: APCDA Chairman Announces 600cc Cars Will Become Cheaper Under Auto Policy
stories.summary: The Chairman of the All Pakistan Car Dealers Association, Mian Shoaib, announced during a press conference in Islamabad that 600cc motor vehicles will experience increased affordability under the framework of the current auto policy. During his address, Mian Shoaib emphasized that a prolonged and difficult effort was required to finally permit the commercial import of vehicles, an initiative that will additionally clear the path for the future importation of electric vehicles into the country. He pointed out that despite the association operating as a recognized segment of the trade community, bureaucratic elements previously established obstacles and plotted to obstruct the commercial importation process. Furthermore, the chairman expressed his appreciation to Federal Minister for Trade Haroon Akhtar and Senator Faisal Vawda for their consistent backing. Explaining the operational mechanics, Mian Shoaib stated that automobiles will be brought into the country via various banking institutions operating under the commercial import framework, a move designed to introduce a broader variety of options to the domestic market and provide consumers with superior purchasing choices. Clarifying regulatory procedures, he noted that while commercial car imports do not maintain a direct connection to the overarching auto policy, mandatory pre-shipment inspections will be enforced prior to importation to verify full compliance with established safety and protective standards. In an unrelated healthcare update, the Sindh Institute of Cardiovascular Diseases delivered free emergency medical services to 22,639 heart attack sufferers across Sindh over the first ten months of the year, while 1,626 individuals received free open-heart procedures through thirty provincial Chest Pain Units.

stories.title: Pakistani Climate Minister Declares Climate Change Civilization's Enemy at SCO Event
stories.summary: Federal Minister for Climate Change Musadik Malik delivered a prominent address at the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation Civilisational Dialogue Forum in New Delhi, designating climate change as a primary adversary to global civilizations. Representing Pakistan on a three-day official visit to India, Malik noted the profound devastation brought by environmental disasters across South Asia, specifically referencing the catastrophic monsoon floods of 2022 in Pakistan that claimed 1,700 lives and submerged one-third of the nation, alongside severe floods in Nepal that resulted in over 1,400 deaths. Addressing an audience near historical cultural landmarks, the minister remarked that four days of rainfall managed to breach the ancient walls of Mohenjo-Daro, a historical site whose name translates to the mound of the dead, which remarkably offered refuge to displaced populations during the recent climate calamities. Presenting three specific proposals to the SCO, Malik called for the creation of a cultural institution network, a digital repository showcasing regional natural and historical gifts, and a climate-resilient heritage framework to combat regional destruction. Opting to deliver his speech in Urdu rather than English due to his proximity to historical literary and spiritual shrines, Malik emphasized the necessity of cultural diversity and the free flow of ideas, comparing civilizations to a vibrant vase containing colorful flowers with distinct fragrances. On the sidelines of the multilateral forum, the Pakistani minister engaged in separate bilateral discussions with Tajik Minister of Culture Sattoriyon Amonzoda and Iranian cultural official Mohammad Mahdi Imanipour to reinforce historic, cultural, and people-to-people connections. Pakistan presently maintains the rotating chairmanship of the SCO Council of Heads of State for the 2026-27 term and prepares to host the organization's upcoming summit in Islamabad in August 2027.

stories.title: GTA 6 Code-in-Box Format Hurts Physical Retailer and GameStop Sales
stories.summary:
Take-Two Interactive announced a record $3.79 billion in global sales on the release date of GTA 6. However, physical retailers failed to benefit from this milestone because many buyers chose digital storefronts on the PlayStation Store and Xbox instead of purchasing the physical code-in-box version. Richard Tewksbury, owner of Super Game Shack, told the BBC that his store sold only five units, with four being the PS5 version, noting that the disc-less format pushed customers toward digital options. Similarly, Bloomberg reported that U.S. GameStop stores may not be seeing higher revenue, with CEO Ryan Cohen stating that the shift to all-digital has hurt both consumers and his business while putting the second-hand market at risk.

Pre-orders had already signaled trouble for the physical version. GameStop employees reported that customers were frequently confused by mostly empty PS5 and Xbox cases, causing some to leave without buying anything. Consequently, certain stores sold only 5 to 11 copies in a day, while the absence of a traditional map in the boxes also discouraged some buyers. Despite collectors protesting the code-in-box format, customers still pre-ordered 32.5 million copies worldwide before launch. Take-Two did not disclose the breakdown between physical and digital sales, but digital platforms clearly captured the majority of the revenue.

The massive success of the Rockstar game occurred despite complaints about the lack of physical media. Industry analysts observe that the strong digital performance is unlikely to deter PlayStation from ending disc production in early 2028. Meanwhile, unrelated health news from Karachi noted that the Sindh Institute of Cardiovascular Diseases (SICVD) provided free emergency medical facilities to 22,639 heart attack patients and performed 1,626 free open-heart surgeries across its 30 Chest Pain Units in Sindh during the first ten months of the year.

stories.title: گلگت بلتستان میں دو دہائیوں کے بعد بلدیاتی انتخابات کا انعقاد
stories.summary:
دو دہائیوں سے زائد طویل عرصے کے بعد گلگت بلتستان میں مقامی حکومت کے انتخابات کا باضابطہ آغاز ہونے جا رہا ہے۔ اس سلسلے میں پہلے مرحلے کے پولنگ کا عمل آنے والی پانچ دسمبر کو گلگت، اسکردو اور چلاس کی میونسپل کارپوریشنز میں منعقد کیا جائے گا، جہاں شہری اپنے مقامی قائدین کا انتخاب کریں گے۔

اس انتخابی عمل کو اختیارات کو نچلی سطح تک منتقل کرنے اور عوامی نوعیت کے روزمرہ مسائل کے حل کی سمت ایک اہم قدم کے طور پر دیکھا جا رہا ہے۔ بلدیاتی ایکٹ 2014 کے تحت ہونے والے ان انتخابات میں پہلی مرتبہ تینوں میونسپل کارپوریشنز کے ذریعے شہری آبادی کو مقامی سطح پر نمائندگی میسر آئے گی۔

گلگت میونسپل کارپوریشن میں کل بیالیس عمومی نشستوں پر براہ راست ووٹنگ ہوگی، جبکہ دس مخصوص نشستوں پر جن میں سات خواتین کی نشستیں بھی شامل ہیں، نئے منتخب ہونے والے ارکان اپنے ووٹ کے ذریعے فیصلہ کریں گے۔

انتخابی عمل کو مکمل طور پر شفاف، آزاد اور پرامن رکھنے کے لیے تمام انتظامات اور سکیورٹی کے منصوبوں کو حتمی شکل دی جا رہی ہے۔ اس مقصد کے لیے ڈسٹرکٹ ریٹرننگ افسران کی تعیناتی بھی عمل میں آ چکی ہے تاکہ یہ نظام عوام کے لیے موثر ثابت ہو۔

stories.title: جہلم کے نواحی گاؤں میں دلہا کو خشک میوہ جات کا گانہ باندھ دیا گیا
stories.summary:
جہلم کے قریب واقع ایک گاؤں نوگراں میں محبت اور انوکھے انداز کا اظہار کرتے ہوئے دوستوں نے اپنے دلہا کو خشک میوہ جات سے تیار کردہ ایک منفرد اور طویل گانہ پہنایا۔ اس گانے کی لمبائی ساٹھ فٹ اور وزن دس کلو گرام تھا۔

دلہے کے دوستوں کا اس حوالے سے کہنا تھا کہ اس گانے کو بنانے میں پورے تین دن کا وقت صرف ہوا، جبکہ اس کی کل لاگت اسی ہزار روپے آئی۔ اس تقریب کے دوران دوستوں نے نہ صرف خشک میوہ جات کا گانہ پہنایا بلکہ نقد نوٹوں کے ہار بھی دلہے کے گلے میں ڈالے۔

اس موقع پر شادی کی تقریب میں شریک افراد نے نوٹ نچھاور کیے اور روایتی ڈھول کی تھاپ پر بھرپور انداز میں رقص کرکے اپنی خوشی کا اظہار کیا۔

اس قسم کے انوکھے اور روایتی انداز دیہی علاقوں میں شادی کی تقریبات کا حصہ بنتے ہیں جو مقامی لوگوں کی آپسی محبت اور انوکھے طریقہ کار کی عکاسی کرتے ہیں اور تقریب کو یادگار بناتے ہیں۔

stories.title: مسلم لیگ ن سندھ کے صدر بشیر میمن کی اہلیہ انتقال کرگئیں
stories.summary:
پاکستان مسلم لیگ (ن) سندھ کے صدر اور معروف سیاسی شخصیت بشیر میمن کی اہلیہ اس جہان فانی سے کوچ کر گئیں۔ اہل خانہ کے مطابق ان کا انتقال کراچی میں ان کی اپنی رہائش گاہ پر ہوا۔

سوگوار خاندان نے بتایا کہ مرحومہ کو ان کے آبائی علاقے اولڈ ہالہ، ضلع مٹیاری میں لے جایا جائے گا جہاں ان کی تدفین عمل میں لائی جائے گی۔

مسلم لیگ ن کے رہنما بشیر میمن نے اپنی اہلیہ کے حوالے سے بتایا کہ وہ دل کا دورہ پڑنے اور برین ہیمرج کے ناگہانی صدمے کے بعد سے شدید علیل تھیں۔

ان کے اس صدمے پر سیاسی و سماجی حلقوں کی طرف سے گہرے دکھ اور افسوس کا اظہار کیا جا رہا ہے، اور ان کے اہلِ خانہ سے تعزیت کا سلسلہ جاری ہے۔

stories.title: کراچی: اغوا برائے تاوان کیس کے مفرور ملزم کا عدالت میں سرنڈر
stories.summary:
جنوبی افریقا سے پاکستان تشریف لانے والے ایک شہری کے مبینہ اغوا اور تاوان کے حصول کے مقدمے میں مفرور رہنے والے ایک ملزم نے کراچی کی انسداد دہشت گردی عدالت میں پیش ہو کر خود کو قانون کے حوالے کر دیا۔ عدالت نے پیش ہونے پر ملزم کی ضمانت کی درخواست منظور کر لی۔

عدالتی کارروائی کے دوران ملزم کے وکیل نے مؤقف اختیار کیا کہ ان کے موکل کا اس مقدمے کی کارروائی اور جرم سے کوئی تعلق نہیں ہے، جبکہ اس مقدمے میں نامزد دیگر ملزمان پہلے ہی عدالت سے بری ہو چکے ہیں۔

یہ مقدمہ سال 2021 میں کراچی کے تھانہ عزیز بھٹی میں درج کیا گیا تھا، جس میں وفاقی تحقیقاتی ادارے کے حکام کے مطابق ملزم ارمان اور اس کے دیگر ساتھیوں پر متاثرہ شہری سے سولہ لاکھ روپے ہتھیانے کا الزام عائد کیا گیا تھا۔

عدالت کی جانب سے اس کیس کی مزید کارروائی جاری رکھی گئی ہے جبکہ مفرور ملزم کے سرنڈر کرنے کے بعد قانونی تقاضے پورے کیے جا رہے ہیں۔

stories.title: Democrats Prepare Ambitious Legislative Agenda After US Midterm Election Wins
stories.summary:
Following a sweeping victory in the November 3, 2026 midterm elections, Democrats are preparing to take control of the US Congress on January 3, 2027. Empowered by a 56-44 majority in the Senate and a strong House majority ranging from 257 to 172 seats, party leaders plan to unveil an ambitious legislative agenda in early December once the Senate leadership race concludes. This marks a sharp reversal from the previous two years when President Donald Trump’s Republicans held both chambers of Congress. Senator Raphael Warnock of Georgia described the outcome as a political realignment, while veteran Republican Senator John Boozman warned that Trump remains a powerful force whose vetoes will be difficult to override.

Addressing the high cost of living, which voters identified as a top concern, Democratic lawmakers plan to target key areas to unite both progressives and moderates. Early legislative priorities include curbing presidential war powers regarding Iran to help lower gasoline prices, reversing Republican cuts to SNAP food stamp and Medicaid programs, and banning lawmakers from engaging in stock insider trading. Meanwhile, progressives are pushing for a higher federal minimum wage—potentially raising it from the current $7.25, unchanged since 2009, to between $20 and $25—alongside broader proposals like cutting aid to Israel, halting new AI data centers, reforming campaign finance, and tackling climate change.

Republicans face a difficult political bind regarding whether to cooperate with the incoming majority or risk angering voters. While senators like Boozman acknowledge the necessity of addressing exorbitant healthcare premiums, they intend to seek guidance from Trump. Other senior lawmakers are focusing on complex issues, with retiring Senator Dick Durbin advocating for comprehensive, bipartisan immigration reform that balances border security with pathways to citizenship, avoiding extreme deportation tactics. Moderate Democrats are also exploring phased universal healthcare concepts, such as lowering the Medicare eligibility age to 55, while representatives like Chellie Pingree prepare subcommittees to protect clean air, clean water, and environmental standards.

stories.title: Pakistan Conditions Resumed Talks With India on New Delhi's Behavior
stories.summary:
Pakistan’s Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister, Ishaq Dar, stated that the resumption of diplomatic dialogue with India relies entirely on New Delhi’s conduct. In an interview with international broadcaster Euronews, Dar noted that the Indus Waters Treaty cannot be suspended immediately and emphasized that unilateral actions and bloc politics are ineffective solutions for resolving regional disputes.

Addressing other geopolitical issues, Dar highlighted that diplomacy is the only viable method to de-escalate tensions between the United States and Iran, noting that regional forums are actively working toward this goal. He also reaffirmed Pakistan's commitment to upholding the June 18 agreement despite alleged violations from opposing parties.

Regarding the situation in Afghanistan, Dar stressed that Islamabad requires firm guarantees that Afghan soil will not be used to launch attacks against Pakistan or any other nation. He demanded verifiable actions against militant factions operating in the region, specifically naming the banned Tehreek-e-Taliban Pakistan (TTP), the Balochistan Liberation Army (BLA), the Majeed Brigade, and Daish, also known as Islamic State (IS).

The report also included domestic public health figures from Karachi, noting that the Sindh Institute of Cardiovascular Diseases (SICVD) treated 22,639 heart attack patients across Sindh and performed 1,626 free open-heart surgeries during the first ten months of the year using its 30 provincial Chest Pain Units.

stories.title: WhatsApp Increases Group Chat Size Limit to 1,500 Members
stories.summary:
WhatsApp has increased its maximum group chat size limit from 1,024 to 1,500 members. According to WABetaInfo, the update is rolling out gradually for both Android and iOS users, applying to standard group conversations as well as individual groups operating within WhatsApp Communities.

This update builds upon previous expansions, following a November 2022 update that doubled the capacity from 512 to 1,024 members. With the new limit, group admins can now add 476 additional participants to a single chat, nearly tripling the platform's group capacity over a four-year period. This adjustment provides a more practical option for schools, clubs, and large organizations that previously had to split members across multiple chats.

Existing groups will automatically receive the capacity upgrade without requiring admins to change any settings. While individual chats within Communities are affected by this change, Community announcement groups remain capped at a separate limit of 2,000 members. Additionally, a brief public health update noted that the Sindh Institute of Cardiovascular Diseases (SICVD) in Karachi provided free emergency medical care to 22,639 heart attack patients and completed 1,626 free open-heart surgeries across its 30 provincial Chest Pain Units during the first ten months of the year.

stories.title: Australia Wins First T20 Against England Following Thrilling Finish
stories.summary: Australia secured a narrow three-wicket victory with just one ball remaining against England in the opening match of their five-match T20 international series on Saturday. The encounter took place at the Melbourne Cricket Ground, where England posted a total of 187-9, marking the highest T20I score at the venue. England captain Harry Brook led the visitors' batting effort with a rapid 65 runs from 20 deliveries before falling to Nikhil Chaudhary. In response, Australia's run chase began poorly with early setbacks, but Nikhil Chaudhary contributed 66 runs from 38 balls. Jack Edwards then delivered a decisive unbeaten knock of 25 runs from 11 balls, successfully guiding Australia to 188 and securing a 1-0 series lead. Australian captain Mitchell Marsh praised the younger members of the squad following the tense finish, while Brook noted that his team fell slightly short of a winning total on that pitch.

stories.title: Hacker Releases Portions of GTA 6 Xbox Version, Prompting PC Hopes
stories.summary: Following the release of GTA 6 on November 19, a hacker named Cyberleek published substantial segments of the Xbox version online. This data leak has sparked speculation that an unofficial PC port could emerge soon through a code adaptation process known as recompilation. Cyberleek suggested that modders might make the title playable on personal computers within a week, though the executable file necessary to launch the game is not expected until November 23. This development has gained traction among PC players frustrated by Rockstar's traditional approach of launching games on consoles first and delaying computer editions. While the unofficial release has received backing on Reddit, experts and developers have raised concerns regarding potential revenue loss and financial risks for studios, which could prompt publishers to implement more restrictive always-online requirements in the future.

stories.title: Two Suspects Confess to Torturing Young Domestic Worker Fatima Asghar
stories.summary: Police sources in Islamabad confirmed that two arrested individuals have admitted to torturing 13-year-old domestic worker Fatima Asghar, whose death case has drawn significant attention. The suspects in custody include a Qari and the wife of an Federal Investigation Agency director. Authorities have also recovered an electric iron and a stick believed to have been utilized in the assaults. Investigators reviewed video recordings and closed-circuit television footage showing the minor being physically abused and pleading inside the residence, along with photographs documenting burn marks on her body. The post-mortem examination, conducted by the Pakistan Institute of Medical Sciences, recorded roughly 20 fresh and old injuries extending from her head to her feet, alongside severe swelling and blood clots in internal organs such as the heart and kidneys. Police are continuing their legal proceedings and investigations utilizing these autopsy findings, confessions, and recovered evidence.

stories.title: Sindh Chief Minister Inaugurates Renovated Assembly Hall at Historic NJV School
stories.summary: Sindh Chief Minister Syed Murad Ali Shah inaugurated the restored historic Old Sindh Assembly Hall at Narayan Jagannath Vaidya School in Karachi on Saturday during World Children’s Day celebrations. Originally established in October 1855, NJV School is the province's first government institution, with its historic building completed in 1876 and previously utilized for early provincial legislative proceedings after the creation of Pakistan in 1947. During the event, the Chief Minister interacted with students and proposed turning the restored hall into a museum to preserve the region's democratic history. Murad Ali Shah emphasized that educational investment remains a primary objective for the provincial government, noting that NJV projects currently reach approximately 17,000 children across Sindh through 33 educational initiatives. Additionally, the Chief Minister announced the allocation of 15 acres of land in Education City for the institution's future expansion, which will feature a larger hostel, new educational infrastructure, and a modern sports complex.

stories.title: Rawalpindi police submit charge sheet in Hina Javed murder case
stories.summary:
Rawalpindi police have finalized their investigation into the August murder of 45-year-old digital media executive Hina Javed, submitting the formal charge sheet to the court nearly three months after the crime. Rawalpindi City Police Officer Sardar Ghias Gul announced the filing on Saturday, noting that the case involved significant forensic evidence, including DNA profiles from the victim's husband and domestic worker matching samples from the crime scene and postmortem swabs.

Hina's body was discovered in a washroom at her Rawalpindi residence bearing severe signs of torture, such as a strangulation mark, facial injuries, and nasal bleeding. Dismissing the possibility of suicide, investigators arrested the victim's husband and a domestic servant named Zeeshan, both of whom were placed on judicial remand, while her father-in-law was also questioned. The case drew intense public and official scrutiny after the victim's family accused authorities of evidence tampering and demanded a special judicial commission, leading the Punjab government to form a review committee.

The investigation's handling prompted parliamentary attention, with the National Assembly Standing Committee on Interior and Narcotics Control summoning high-ranking officials like the Punjab IGP. Punjab Chief Minister Maryam Nawaz stated that polygraph and DNA results pointed toward the servant, though inquiries remained ongoing. First Lady Aseefa Bhutto Zardari also met with the grieving family in October to endorse consideration of their call for a judicial commission.

The case matters significantly because it highlights ongoing public distrust in local police investigations and underscores systemic issues within the prosecution framework. By bringing official scrutiny to bear on forensic integrity and police accountability, the proceedings serve as a major test for the justice system in handling high-profile domestic violence and homicide cases in the region.

stories.title: Astronomers observe rare star merger inside the Andromeda Galaxy
stories.summary:
Astronomers have documented a rare stellar merger event inside the Andromeda Galaxy, which is situated approximately 2.53 million light-years away from the Milky Way. The findings detailing this phenomenon were officially published in the journal Nature on November 18, 2026. Researchers focused on a celestial system where one star was swallowed by another, creating a brief transient event designated as AT 2025abao.

Before the merger, the system consisted of a giant star boasting seven times the mass of the Sun and 18,000 times its brightness, accompanied by a smaller companion star with roughly 70 percent of the Sun's mass. Scientists utilized advanced observation tools, including the Wide-field Infrared Transient Explorer, Neowise, and the James Webb Space Telescope, to monitor the event's progression through multiple stages.

During the collision, the smaller star was gradually trapped within the outer layers of the giant star. As it orbited deep inside the giant's atmosphere, the smaller star lost energy and spiraled inward toward the stellar core. Researchers calculated that this complete engulfment process took place over the course of just seven orbits.

This discovery provides astronomers with unique insights into complex stellar interactions and late-stage binary evolution. Observing such rare phenomena helps scientists better understand the dynamic forces at play within distant galactic systems, expanding our knowledge of stellar mechanics beyond our own solar neighborhood.

stories.title: Gold prices plunge in Pakistan amid global market volatility
stories.summary:
Gold prices in Pakistan experienced a steep decline on Saturday, dropping by Rs3,500 per tola according to figures released by the All Pakistan Sarafa Gems and Jewellers Association. Following this latest downward adjustment, the domestic cost of gold per tola decreased to Rs376,336, while the price for 10 grams fell by Rs3,001 to reach Rs322,647. Domestically, these rates are determined using the interbank exchange rate.

This local slump mirrored international trends, as global gold prices decreased by $35 per ounce to settle at $3,538. Despite functioning traditionally as a safe-haven asset, gold has encountered mounting downward pressure driven by broader financial market volatility and economic uncertainty. Key factors contributing to this instability include market tensions surrounding the Iran war, elevated energy costs, fluctuating technology stocks linked to artificial intelligence, and rising levels of government debt.

In response to these conditions, market analysts have lowered their gold price forecasts for 2026 across consecutive quarters, largely pointing to a stronger US dollar and higher US Treasury yields. However, industry surveys indicate expectations that prices may recover by 2027. Alongside gold, traders and analysts have also reduced their price projections for platinum and palladium for the third quarter in a row.

These market shifts matter because they reflect broader economic anxieties and monetary policy impacts that influence investor behavior worldwide. The fluctuations directly affect domestic jewelry markets and individual investors in Pakistan, altering the landscape for traditional wealth preservation assets.

stories.title: Musadik Malik urges evidence-based mechanism for India-Pakistan terrorism concerns
stories.summary:
Federal Climate Minister Musadik Malik has advocated for the creation of a transparent, evidence-based mechanism to address terrorism-related concerns between Pakistan and India. Speaking informally to reporters on the sidelines of the SCO Civilisational Dialogue Forum in New Delhi on Friday, Malik argued that both nations should present concrete proof rather than relying on mutual accusations.

Malik emphasized that multilateral discussions at the forum should not be narrowed down to bilateral disputes, noting that the wider region faces complex security challenges involving Afghanistan, Central Asia, and Iran. Nevertheless, addressing the terrorism issue specifically, he highlighted that Pakistan has suffered thousands of casualties and stressed the necessity of transparency whenever the subject is raised. He asserted that establishing a structured, evidence-driven approach is a proposal Pakistan has put forward repeatedly to foster trust and find lasting solutions.

Acknowledging that both Pakistan and India have encountered terrorist incidents, Malik stated that his country seeks permanent resolutions rather than engaging in reciprocal blame games or focusing solely on isolated events. He clarified that his remarks were not intended to present a narrative of mere victimhood, noting that Pakistan is actively working to manage the situation on the ground.

This call for a structured framework matters because it highlights Pakistan's diplomatic stance on regional security and bilateral engagement. By pushing for verifiable proof over political rhetoric, the proposal aims to de-escalate tensions and promote constructive dialogue between the two neighboring nuclear-armed states.

stories.title: Iran States Key Allies China and Russia Oppose Nuclear Doctrine Shift
stories.summary:
Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi stated that strategic allies China and Russia oppose any alteration to Tehran's nuclear doctrine. Araghchi discussed the sensitive topic in an interview published Saturday with the state-run Iran Daily, acknowledging that the domestic debate is broad and serious with both supporters and opponents. Hardliners within Iran have recently called for a policy shift to allow the development of a nuclear deterrent following heavy attacks on Iranian nuclear facilities during conflicts with Israel and the United States.

Despite these domestic pressures, Araghchi emphasized that Iran's official positions remain unchanged and its doctrine has not been modified. The ongoing debate coincides with restricted access for the International Atomic Energy Agency, which Iran has barred from inspecting its facilities due to security concerns and the agency's failure to condemn US and Israeli strikes. While the UN nuclear watchdog recently urged Iran to permit incremental inspector access, Tehran continues to reference a religious decree by former supreme leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei that prohibits weapons of mass destruction.

Former leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei was killed in a US-Israeli strike on February 28, which sparked a wider regional conflict involving missile and drone exchanges. His successor and son, Mojtaba Khamenei, has remained out of public view since his March appointment and has not issued any new decree to override his father's ruling. Araghchi noted that advocates on both sides of the nuclear doctrine debate present their own arguments, but official policy remains grounded in the historical fatwa.

Separately, in Karachi, Sindh Chief Minister Syed Murad Ali Shah inaugurated the renovated historic Old Sindh Assembly Hall at the Narayan Jagannath Vaidya School on Saturday. Speaking at World Children's Day celebrations at the school, the Chief Minister reaffirmed his administration's dedication to delivering quality education and equal opportunities for children throughout the province.

stories.title: Cricket Commentators Warner and Khawaja Resting Amid Sandpapergate Fallout
stories.summary:
Fox Sports pulled former Australian cricketers Usman Khawaja and David Warner from television commentary duties on Saturday to shield them from the ongoing controversy surrounding the 2018 Sandpapergate scandal. The retired pair will miss Australia's entire Twenty20 series against England. The storm reignited after Khawaja asserted in his recent autobiography that the entire Test team was aware of the ball-tampering plot in Cape Town, a claim subsequently backed by Warner and Cameron Bancroft. A previous Cricket Australia investigation had pinned responsibility solely on Bancroft, Warner, and then-captain Steve Smith.

The broadcasting decision followed Cricket Australia's expression of unanimous support for current Test captain Pat Cummins, who has faced intense scrutiny and denied any prior knowledge of the incident. Fox Sports managing director Steve Crawley explained that the commentators were being rested because the relentless media cycle made it unfair to expect them to focus on the game and continuously respond to unfolding developments. Crawley noted that while the network values diverse commentary perspectives, the current pressure is simply too high.

It remains undetermined when Khawaja and Warner will resume their broadcasting roles for the network. Following the ongoing five-match T20 series that began in Melbourne, the Australian team is scheduled to play a four-Test series against New Zealand spanning December and January. Network executives stated they will continue monitoring the situation as the fallout from the historic controversy continues to affect current and former players alike.

stories.title: Pakistan Meteorological Department Issues Drought Alert for Three Regions
stories.summary:
The Pakistan Meteorological Department issued a regional drought alert for Sindh, Balochistan, and southern Punjab following a persistent and cumulative precipitation deficit. The warning highlights significant rainfall shortfalls during the crucial monsoon season from July to September, compounded by below-normal precipitation across these areas for five consecutive months between July and November. Specifically, Balochistan recorded 79 percent less rainfall than normal in the first 20 days of November, while southern Punjab saw a 74 percent drop during the same period.

Officials cautioned that prolonged dry spells and ongoing rainfall deficits could severely worsen drought conditions throughout the upcoming winter months. The Met Office warned that this weather pattern threatens agricultural production, livestock health, and domestic water availability for millions of residents in vulnerable areas. The department's National Drought Monitoring and Early Warning Centre advised provincial governments to implement precautionary measures to combat the emerging crisis, noting that below-normal rainfall from December 2026 to February 2027 could exacerbate water shortages.

The combined effect of depleted soil moisture, increased evapotranspiration stress, and constrained water resources is expected to hit rain-fed agricultural zones and water-scarce regions the hardest. Authorities stressed the importance of early intervention to mitigate the impact on domestic and agricultural supplies. Meanwhile, in Karachi, Sindh Chief Minister Syed Murad Ali Shah inaugurated the renovated historic Old Sindh Assembly Hall at Narayan Jagannath Vaidya School on Saturday, using the World Children's Day event to reaffirm his government's commitment to provincial education.

stories.title: Bangladesh Deploys Paramilitary Troops to Curb Arson and Political Violence
stories.summary:
Bangladesh authorities deployed hundreds of additional paramilitary troops across the country on Saturday to suppress a wave of arson attacks and political unrest. The violence has involved the torching of police stations, banks, and homes belonging to political rivals. The current unrest coincides with announcements from 79-year-old ousted leader Sheikh Hasina that she plans to return from India in December, despite receiving a death sentence in absentia for crimes against humanity linked to a deadly 2024 uprising crackdown.

At least four individuals have died in political clashes since November 14, including three party activists and a bus worker killed when his vehicle was set on fire. In the latest incident in Narail on Friday, supporters of slain Bangladesh Nationalist Party activists set fire to more than a dozen homes belonging to individuals linked to Hasina's banned Awami League party. Local residents reported that as many as 50 houses were damaged, leaving communities terrified and keeping women and children indoors. Fire officers attempting to respond to the blazes faced obstacles when logs were placed across roads by rioters.

In response to the escalating violence, state news agency BSS reported the nationwide deployment of 90 additional platoons of the Border Guard Bangladesh paramilitary force. National police chief Md Ali Hossain Fakir announced that security had been successfully restored in Gopalganj, Hasina's hometown and a traditional party stronghold, while urging peace-loving citizens to oppose sabotage. Authorities have also heightened security around industrial zones to manage separate protests by garment sector workers demanding a living wage.

stories.title: Police clear husband and father-in-law in Hina Javed murder case
stories.summary:
Police investigators in Islamabad have submitted a challan to the prosecution branch declaring the husband and father-in-law of the late Hina Javed innocent. Instead, authorities have named a domestic employee, Zeeshan, as the sole and main accused in the murder investigation. Section 376 of the Pakistan Penal Code pertaining to rape has also been incorporated into the legal proceedings.

Hina Javed was discovered dead under suspicious conditions inside a bathroom at her apartment located in the Lal Kurti area of Rawalpindi on August 20, 2026. Investigators determined that Zeeshan, who was residing in the apartment building's servant quarters, was the prime suspect. Meanwhile, the victim's husband, Faisal Asghar, had been residing with his father on the second floor of the same building.

The conclusion of the police probe follows intense scrutiny and public expressions of distrust from the victim's family regarding how authorities handled the case. Last month, the family submitted an open letter to Punjab Chief Minister Maryam Nawaz demanding an independent judicial commission, and they also approached the National Commission for Human Rights to allege that the initial investigation was compromised. Prior to the challan submission, the family criticized authorities for taking 86 days without filing charges.

In response to inquiries on the social media platform X, Punjab Chief Minister Maryam Nawaz previously stated she was closely monitoring the case. The recent developments mark a significant procedural step as the legal process moves forward through the prosecution branch.

stories.title: Iran says Russia and China oppose shifting its nuclear doctrine
stories.summary:
Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi stated that both China and Russia are against altering Tehran's current nuclear doctrine. In an interview published on Saturday by the state-run Iran Daily newspaper, Araghchi acknowledged that domestic debate over changing the doctrine is a serious issue featuring both supporters and opponents. Despite these internal discussions, he confirmed that official positions and the existing doctrine remain unchanged.

The internal debate among Iranian political factions, particularly hardliners, resurfaced following recent military conflicts with the United States and Israel that resulted in heavy strikes on Iran's nuclear facilities. Proponents of a doctrine shift argue that developing a nuclear weapon would provide a vital deterrent. In response to security concerns and a lack of international condemnation regarding the strikes on its facilities, Iran has barred inspectors from the International Atomic Energy Agency from accessing its nuclear sites. The UN watchdog recently urged Tehran to permit inspector access to key locations.

Iranian officials frequently cite a religious decree, or fatwa, issued by the late supreme leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei that bans weapons of mass destruction, including nuclear arms. Ayatollah Khamenei was killed during a US-Israeli strike on his compound in central Tehran on February 28, an event that sparked a wider regional conflict involving missile and drone exchanges. His successor and son, Mojtaba Khamenei, took office in March but has remained largely out of public view and has not issued any new decree to override his father's previous ruling.

The stance of strategic partners China and Russia carries weight as Iranian leadership weighs domestic pressures against international diplomatic considerations. Araghchi emphasized that both countries share cooperative agreements with Tehran and maintain their opposition to any policy modifications at this stage.

stories.title: Bayern Munich striker Harry Kane vows return following ankle surgery
stories.summary:
Bayern Munich forward Harry Kane has successfully undergone surgery on his left ankle after tearing a ligament during a match. The England captain limped off the pitch just 20 minutes into Friday's 1-1 home draw against Cologne in the Bundesliga. Following the procedure on Saturday, the club announced that the 33-year-old player will immediately begin his rehabilitation program, with an expected recovery timeline of three to four months.

Kane shared a message with his followers from his hospital bed, acknowledging the physical setback while expressing determination to recover for the decisive portion of the campaign. He stated that the situation presents an opportunity to demonstrate resilience ahead of 2027 and vowed to return fresh for the business end of the season. He also included a motivational quote from former NFL player Julian Edelman and thanked supporters for their encouraging messages.

Although Kane has a history of ankle problems, he has missed very few games since transferring to Bayern Munich in 2023. England manager Thomas Tuchel will be closely monitoring his rehabilitation ahead of the national team's upcoming Nations League quarter-final fixtures against Norway scheduled for late March.

The injury presents a significant challenge for Bayern Munich, who are already managing a depleted squad, particularly in the attacking line. The team is currently missing several key personnel including Luis Diaz, Serge Gnabry, Alphonso Davies, Ismael Saibari, and captain Manuel Neuer, though midfielder Jamal Musiala and coach Vincent Kompany recently returned from their own long-term absences.

stories.title: Bayern Munich forward Harry Kane undergoes successful ankle surgery
stories.summary:
Bayern Munich star striker Harry Kane has pledged to return for the crucial final stretch of the season after undergoing successful surgery on his left ankle on Saturday. The England captain suffered a torn ligament in his ankle and limped off after just 20 minutes of play during Bayern's 1-1 home draw against Cologne in the Bundesliga on Friday. The club confirmed the procedure in a statement, noting that the 33-year-old player will now embark on a rehabilitation program expected to sideline him for three to four months.

Kane took to social media from his hospital bed on Saturday to share his thoughts on the setback, viewing it as an opportunity to build resilience and improve heading into 2027. He expressed confidence in returning in top form for the remainder of the campaign while quoting former Super Bowl-winning wide receiver Julian Edelman, noting that tough people outlast tough times, and thanked well-wishers for their support.

While Kane has experienced ankle issues in the past, he has missed only a handful of matches since joining Bayern in 2023. England coach Thomas Tuchel will closely follow his recovery progress, as England is set to face Norway in the Nations League quarter-finals late in March.

The timing of the injury compounds difficulties for Bayern Munich, who are currently navigating a shortage of available players, especially in attacking positions. The German club is missing Luis Diaz, Serge Gnabry, Alphonso Davies, Ismael Saibari, and captain Manuel Neuer, while midfielder Jamal Musiala and coach Vincent Kompany only recently returned from lengthy layoffs.

stories.title: پی سی بی نے نئے سینٹرل کانٹریکٹس کا اعلان کر دیا
stories.summary:
پاکستان کرکٹ بورڈ نے آئندہ دو برس کے لیے 38 کرکٹرز کو نئے سینٹرل کانٹریکٹس جاری کر دیے ہیں، جن کا نفاذ 30 جون 2027 تک ہوگا۔ اس نئی فہرست میں سابق کپتان محمد رضوان، شان مسعود، امام الحق، صائم ایوب اور عبداللہ شفیق سمیت کئی سینئر کھلاڑیوں کو شامل نہیں کیا گیا۔

نئے کانٹریکٹس کا اعلان لاہور میں ہائی پرفارمنس کے ڈائریکٹر اور ہیڈ کوچ مائیک ہیسن نے ایک نیوز کانفرنس میں کیا۔ فہرست میں بابر اعظم اور سلمان علی آغا کو ٹیسٹ اور ون ڈے کیٹیگری دی گئی ہے، جبکہ متعدد کھلاڑیوں کو ون ڈے، ٹی ٹوئنٹی اور صرف ٹیسٹ یا ٹی ٹوئنٹی فارمیٹ کے لیے چنا گیا ہے۔ اس کے علاوہ 19 نوجوان کرکٹرز کو ڈیولپمنٹ کیٹیگری میں رکھا گیا ہے۔

محمد رضوان کو شامل نہ کرنے پر عاقب جاوید نے وضاحت دی کہ رضوان کی خدمات بہت ہیں لیکن کانٹریکٹ ملنے والے ہی صرف سلیکٹ ہوں یہ ضروری نہیں۔ سوشل میڈیا پر بھی اس فیصلے پر ملے جلے ردعمل کا اظہار کیا گیا ہے، جہاں کچھ مبصرین نے اسے نئی شروعات قرار دیا جبکہ دیگر نے اس پر سوالات اٹھائے ہیں۔

ان فیصلوں کے پس منظر میں لارڈز ٹیسٹ کے بعد کھلاڑیوں کی واپسی اور ستمبر میں میڈیا پر آنے والی اندرونی تادیبی تحقیقات کی خبریں بھی زیر بحث رہیں۔ پی سی بی کا مقصد اس تبدیلی کے ذریعے نوجوان ٹیلنٹ کو آگے لانا اور مسابقتی صلاحیت کو برقرار رکھنا ہے۔

stories.title: عمران خان اور بشریٰ بی بی کی اڈیالہ جیل میں ملاقات
stories.summary:
اڈیالہ جیل راولپنڈی میں پاکستان تحریک انصاف (پی ٹی آئی) کے بانی چیئرمین اور ان کی اہلیہ بشریٰ بی بی کے درمیان ملاقات کا انعقاد کیا گیا ہے۔ جیل ذرائع کے مطابق یہ ملاقات جیل کے کانفرنس روم میں کروائی گئی جو کہ چالیس منٹ تک جاری رہی۔

اس کے علاوہ ملک بھر کی دیگر سیاسی اور قانونی خبروں میں گورنر خیبر پختونخوا فیصل کریم کنڈی کا کہنا ہے کہ مولانا فضل الرحمان کو خطرہ لاحق ہونے کی صورت میں لازمی سیکیورٹی فراہم کی جانی چاہیے۔ کراچی کی انسداد دہشت گردی عدالت میں جنوبی افریقا سے پاکستان آنے والے ایک شہری کے اغوا برائے تاوان کے مقدمے میں مطلوب مفرور ملزم نے خود کو قانون کے حوالے کر دیا ہے۔

گلگت بلتستان میں بائیس سال کے طویل وقفے کے بعد بلدیاتی انتخابات کی تیاریوں کا سلسلہ شروع ہو چکا ہے۔ پہلے مرحلے کے تحت پانچ دسمبر دو ہزار چھبیس کو گلگت، اسکردو اور چلاس کی میونسپل کارپوریشنز میں باقاعدہ جماعتی بنیادوں پر انتخابات منعقد کیے جائیں گے۔ دریں اثنا مسلم لیگ ن کے رہنما بشیر میمن نے بتایا ہے کہ ان کی اہلیہ دل کا دورہ پڑنے اور برین ہیمرج کے بعد سے علیل ہیں۔

پاک بھارت تعلقات کے حوالے سے ڈاکٹر مصدق ملک نے خطے میں باہمی تعلقات کی بہتری کی امید کا اظہار کیا ہے۔ ان کا کہنا تھا کہ بدلتی ہوئی جغرافیائی سیاست اور طاقت کے توازن کے تناظر میں اب علاقائی مکالمے اور تعاون کی ضرورت پہلے سے کہیں زیادہ بڑھ گئی ہے۔ دریں اثنا ایوان صدر کے اعلامیے کے مطابق خیبر پختونخوا اسپیکر اور ڈپٹی اسپیکر آرڈیننس دو ہزار چھبیس کی منظوری بھی دے دی گئی ہے۔

stories.title: Deadly Fire at Southern Iraq Power Station Leaves Four Dead
stories.summary:
At least four individuals lost their lives and thirty others sustained injuries following a major fire that erupted at a power facility in southern Iraq on Saturday. Security personnel and authorities warn that the final casualty count could climb further as recovery efforts continue. Civil defence units and firefighters were dispatched to the scene, successfully bringing the blaze at the Hartha facility, situated north of Basra, under control.

According to security officials and reports from the state news agency INA, the destructive flames extended outward to affect neighboring residential properties and forced a complete halt to electricity generation operations at the site. Prior to the incident, the installation possessed an overall generating capacity of 800 megawatts, although it was functioning at approximately 400 megawatts when the fire broke out. State news sources confirmed that no immediate official details were available regarding the underlying catalyst of the blaze or the total financial cost of the physical destruction.

This incident highlights ongoing vulnerabilities within the nation's power sector, which has historically suffered from prolonged underinvestment, deficient maintenance protocols, and a consistent inability to satisfy peak consumer demand, especially during harsh summer heatwaves. Previous technical malfunctions and fires at various substations and energy facilities have frequently triggered widespread regional blackouts and interrupted essential utility services across the country.

The occurrence of such critical infrastructure failures underscores the severe challenges facing regional energy administration. While local emergency responders managed to secure the immediate area, the broader implications of the disrupted energy generation capacity remain a significant concern for residents and authorities alike who depend on the facility for daily electricity.

stories.title: Broadcasters Bench Cricket Commentators Amid 2018 Ball-Tampering Controversy
stories.summary:
Former Australian cricketers Usman Khawaja and David Warner have been temporarily removed from their television commentary positions with Fox Sports. The decision was announced on Saturday and ensures that both retired athletes will sit out the entirety of Australia's ongoing Twenty20 series against England. Network executives took the action as the intense media storm surrounding the 2018 "Sandpapergate" scandal continues to dominate sports headlines.

The controversy reignited more than two weeks ago when Khawaja asserted in his newly published autobiography that the entire team possessed prior knowledge of the plot to alter the condition of the ball during a Test match against South Africa held in Cape Town. An official Cricket Australia investigation conducted at the time had previously blamed only three individuals: then-captain Steve Smith, his deputy Warner, and Cameron Bancroft, who physically used the sandpaper on the pitch. Following Khawaja's recent assertions, both Warner and Bancroft corroborated the claims, placing immense pressure on current Test captain Pat Cummins, who has firmly denied any prior awareness of the scheme and received unanimous backing from Cricket Australia.

Steve Crawley, the managing director of Fox Sports, explained the network's reasoning to Australian media outlets. He noted that while the organization values diverse perspectives among its broadcast team, the intense public scrutiny and the unfair burden placed on the commentators to address every new development made it increasingly difficult for them to concentrate on the matches. Consequently, both figures will be rested from broadcasts over the upcoming weeks while the network continuously assesses the unfolding situation.

The duration of their suspension remains uncertain, particularly as Australia prepares for a sequence of four Test matches against New Zealand scheduled between December and January, following the conclusion of the five-game T20 series that commenced in Melbourne.

stories.title: Government Rejects PTI Demand for Parity on Electoral Reforms Body
stories.summary:
The administration in Islamabad has formally rejected a demand put forward by the Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf for equal representation within the proposed parliamentary committee tasked with handling electoral reforms. Government representatives asserted that there is no historical precedent for granting equal representation to the ruling side and the opposition within such legislative panels. Federal Minister for Parliamentary Affairs Tariq Fazal Chaudhry communicated this definitive stance to PTI Chief Whip Amir Dogar.

Under the government's established formula, the PTI will be allocated a total of seven seats on the committee, a figure determined proportionately based on the party's current strength in parliament. Specifically, the party has been invited to submit five names representing the lower house and two names from the Senate. Minister Chaudhry emphasized that historical records of all past parliamentary committees on electoral reforms demonstrate that seat allocations have consistently relied strictly on numerical ratios rather than parity.

In response to the announcement, Amir Dogar stated that he would convey the administration's decision directly to the party's leadership. He indicated that the PTI parliamentary committee is scheduled to convene during the upcoming session of the National Assembly. During this meeting, party members and opposition leaders will collectively determine their final course of action and decide whether or not to participate in the electoral reforms committee under the proposed terms.

The government has maintained that the objections raised by the PTI regarding the structural formula of the parliamentary body are entirely unacceptable. As consultations continue among opposition ranks, the final participation of the party in the reform process remains contingent upon upcoming internal discussions and legislative deliberations.

stories.title: Pakistani Foreign Minister Dar Advocates Multilateralism and Diplomacy Amid Global Tensions
stories.summary:
Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Ishaq Dar emphasized the necessity of multilateralism during a recent interview with Euronews, declaring that bloc politics and unilateralism are ineffective. Dar highlighted that Pakistan's foreign policy remains independent and stated that diplomacy and dialogue are crucial for resolving global conflicts, including the ongoing tensions between the United States and Iran.

Recalling Pakistan's recent presidency of a United Nations Security Council moot focused on multilateralism, Dar outlined Islamabad's diplomatic involvement. He noted that Pakistan was the first nation to condemn Israel's February 28 attack on Iran and urged restraint. Furthermore, Islamabad hosted direct talks between the US and Iran, culminating in the signing of the Islamabad Memorandum of Understanding on June 18, though Dar expressed regret over subsequent violations and stressed the importance of keeping sea routes open for energy supply stability.

Addressing domestic economic management and foreign relations, Dar pointed out that Pakistan's external debt stands at $130 billion, whereas its estimated potential in mineral and rare earth resources ranges between $6 trillion and $10 trillion. He also commented on relations with Afghanistan, stating that Pakistan desires a stable and prosperous neighbor but remains concerned over uncurbed terrorism, noting that Pakistan has suffered losses of 100,000 lives and Rs150 billion in its economy.

Regarding India, Dar criticized New Delhi's August 5, 2019 constitutional changes regarding Jammu and Kashmir, rejected Indian blame for the May 2025 conflict following the Pahalgam attack, and strongly condemned India's decision to place the Indus Waters Treaty in abeyance. He stressed that weaponizing water jeopardizes the livelihoods, agriculture, and food security of 260 million people in the region.

stories.title: بلوچستان اسمبلی کے رکن سردار عبدالرحمٰن کھیتران پر قتل کا مقدمہ درج
stories.summary:
بلوچستان اسمبلی کے رکن سردار عبدالرحمٰن کھیتران کے خلاف قتل کا مقدمہ درج کر لیا گیا ہے۔ پولیس کے مطابق، اس معاملے میں قتل کے شبے میں ایک ملزم کو گرفتار بھی کیا گیا ہے۔

مقدمے کی مدعیہ نے اپنے بیان میں الزام عائد کیا ہے کہ ان کے والد نے تین ماہ قبل ایک شخص سے زبردستی نکاح کروایا تھا۔ پولیس حکام کا بتانا ہے کہ گرفتار ملزم کی نشاندہی پر قتل کے بعد دفنائے جانے والے تین افراد کی لاشیں برآمد کر لی گئی ہیں۔

برآمد کی گئی لاشوں کی باقیات کو پوسٹ مارٹم کے لیے سول اسپتال کوئٹہ منتقل کر دیا گیا ہے۔ پولیس اس معاملے کی مزید تفتیش کر رہی ہے تاکہ قتل کے اصل محرکات اور اس میں ملوث دیگر افراد کا پتہ لگایا جا سکے۔

stories.title: Pakistani Climate Minister Dr Musadik Malik Urges Regional Cooperation in New Delhi
stories.summary:
Pakistan's Minister for Climate Change and Environmental Coordination, Dr Musadik Malik, arrived in New Delhi, India, to lead his country's delegation at the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) Civilisational Dialogue Forum. His arrival marks the first official trip to India by a Pakistani federal minister since May 2023, when former foreign minister Bilawal Bhutto-Zardari visited Goa.

During his visit, Malik expressed hope that collective engagement among relevant nations would help improve regional stability. He stated that Pakistan supports all efforts aimed at promoting peace and security, noting that Islamabad has consistently played its part in fostering regional stability.

The minister's presence drew sharp criticism from several Indian politicians, including Congress spokesperson Supriya Shrinate, Congress leaders Surendra Rajput and Pramod Tiwari, Samajwadi Party’s Fakhrul Hasan Chand, and NCP (SP)’s Clyde Crasto. These figures accused the ruling Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) government of inconsistency and double standards for inviting a Pakistani official.

In response, the Indian government strongly defended Malik's visit, explaining that invitations were extended to all SCO member states following established multilateral practice. India initially invited Pakistan's heritage minister, after which Islamabad nominated Malik to lead the delegation.

At the forum, Malik emphasized the necessity of increased dialogue under the SCO framework, pointing out that exchanges across diverse cultures and civilizations are vital as geopolitics undergo changes in the region.

stories.title: India Reaches 486-4 at Stumps on Day Three Against New Zealand
stories.summary:
India finished day three of the first Test match against New Zealand at 486-4 at the Basin Reserve in Wellington, securing a 118-run lead with two days remaining in the contest. KL Rahul anchored the innings with a score of 136, while Shubman Gill contributed 98 before being dismissed just before stumps by bowler Jacob Duffy. At the close of play, Rishabh Pant was unbeaten on 55 alongside Anshul Kamboj on zero.

Earlier in the match, opener Yashasvi Jaiswal scored 85 and number three batsman Devdutt Padikkal made 80, ensuring that every member of India's top five recorded a half-century or more. Rahul reached his 13th Test century from 207 balls, completing a set of centuries in every major Test nation outside the subcontinent. He and Padikkal put together a 165-run partnership before Padikkal was bowled by Kyle Jamieson.

New Zealand struggled to break through a flat, dry pitch that offered little assistance to bowlers or spin. Kyle Jamieson was the pick of the home bowlers, finishing the day with figures of 1-57, while Jacob Duffy recorded 1-180 from 29 overs. Despite two full days of play, the pitch showed minimal wear, allowing Rahul and Padikkal to navigate the low and slow bounce comfortably.

During the final session, Gill and Pant combined for a 100-run partnership, with Pant aggressively targeting Duffy with a series of sixes. India resumed the day at 159-1 facing a 209-run deficit, but steadily wore down New Zealand's total through patient defense and calculated attacking strokes. The two-match Test series is set to conclude the following week in Christchurch.

stories.title: ترک تحقیقاتی جہاز 'اوروچ رئیس' تیل و گیس کی تلاش کے لیے پاکستان پہنچ گیا
stories.summary:
ترکی کا جدید سیسمک ریسرچ جہاز 'اوروچ رئیس' پاکستانی پانیوں میں تیل اور گیس کے ذخائر کا سروے کرنے کے لیے کراچی بندرگاہ پہنچ گیا ہے۔ کراچی پورٹ ٹرسٹ کے مطابق اس جہاز کا مقصد سمندر کی تہہ کے نیچے موجود ساختوں کا جائزہ لینا ہے۔

جمعہ کو کراچی میں اس جہاز کے استقبال کے لیے ایک تقریب منعقد کی گئی جس میں پاکستان کے نائب وزیر اعظم اسحاق ڈار، وزیر پیٹرولیم علی پرویز ملک اور ترکی کے وزیر توانائی الپرسلان بائراکتار نے شرکت کی۔ ترک وزیر نے بتایا کہ یہ جہاز انڈس اور مکران بیسنز میں توانائی کے وسائل کا جائزہ لے گا اور ترکش پیٹرولیم 670 مربع کلومیٹر کے علاقے میں تھری ڈی سیسمک ڈیٹا اکٹھا کرے گی۔

ماہرین کے مطابق سیسمک سروے زمین یا سمندر کی تہہ کا الٹراساؤنڈ یا ایکس رے ہوتا ہے جس کے ذریعے زیرِ زمین تہوں کا مطالعہ کیا جاتا ہے۔ اس عمل میں صوتی لہریں استعمال کی جاتی ہیں جو چٹانوں سے ٹکرا کر واپس آتی ہیں اور ان کے تجزیے سے ممکنہ ذخائر کا پتہ لگایا جاتا ہے۔

اگرچہ یہ سروے حتمی ثبوت نہیں ہوتا لیکن اس سے حاصل ہونے والا ڈیٹا مستقبل میں ڈرلنگ کے درست فیصلے کرنے میں مدد دیتا ہے۔ ترک حکام کا ہدف اس سروے کے بعد اگلے سال ڈرلنگ کا عمل شروع کرنا ہے۔

stories.title: Imported Romanian Wheat Arrives at Karachi Port Amid Domestic Price Hikes
stories.summary:
A bulk carrier transporting approximately 50,000 metric tonnes of imported wheat from Romania arrived at Karachi Port on Saturday, according to the Karachi Port Trust. The vessel, named MV Zhong Chang, docked at berths 13 and 14 of the KGTI terminal and carried grain specifically allocated for Punjab, as consumer food costs continue to climb across the country.

According to port authorities, this arrival brings the total volume of imported wheat brought in by the Trading Corporation of Pakistan to over 200,000 tonnes across four separate ships. These preceding shipments were distributed to various regions, including Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Sindh, and Punjab, to manage domestic supply needs.

Despite the continuous influx of foreign wheat, domestic flour and grain prices have persisted on an upward trajectory, causing widespread anxiety among buyers regarding food affordability. Flour mill operators recently raised fine flour prices by Rs20 per kilogram and No. 2.5 flour by Rs15 per kilogram.

Consequently, market rates in Karachi have reached Rs150 per kilogram for raw wheat, while fine flour is retailing at Rs210 per kilogram and No. 2.5 flour is selling for Rs180 per kilogram. The persistent surge in essential food prices despite large-scale imports has heightened public concern over the deepening economic crunch.

stories.title: UKMTO Reports Two Tanker Incidents Near Oman's Khasab in the Strait of Hormuz
stories.summary:
Two separate tanker attack incidents were reported on Saturday in the vicinity of Khasab, Oman, according to the United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations. In the first event, a vessel traveling outbound through the Strait of Hormuz was struck on its stern by an unidentified projectile approximately 11 nautical miles north of Khasab.

Shortly afterward, the UKMTO issued a second alert regarding another tanker that sustained damage to its engine room after being hit by an unverified projectile about 17 nautical miles east of Khasab. Maritime authorities noted that it remained uncertain whether both reports involved the same ship, and no casualties were immediately confirmed from either occurrence.

The latest security alerts follow a similar vessel attack near Khasab on Friday that sparked a fire onboard, as reported by the British maritime security agency. These incidents take place near the Musandam Peninsula at the entrance of the Strait of Hormuz, a vital maritime chokepoint that historically transported nearly one-fifth of global crude oil supplies before regional conflicts escalated.

stories.title: Pakistan Cricket Board Announces New Contracts for 38 Men's Cricketers
stories.summary:
The Pakistan Cricket Board unveiled central contracts for 38 men’s cricketers on Saturday, utilizing a revamped, format-based structure that highlights specialized roles and developing talent. Running from November 1, 2026, to June 30, 2027, the agreements replace the former A-to-D grading system with five distinct tracks based on format commitments. High-profile players like former captain Mohammad Rizwan, Shan Masood, and Saim Ayub were notably omitted from the new list, alongside others such as Hasan Ali and Mohammad Nawaz. The updated roster features eight additional players compared to the prior cycle, including 19 athletes placed in a newly established development category.

Speaking at Gaddafi Stadium, selection committee member and high performance director Aaqib Javed explained that the changes followed consultations with selectors and coaches to pinpoint athletes expected to play specific formats soon. Head coach Mike Hesson noted the model provides players with clear roles and helps management plan preparations. The five tracks comprise AB for Test and ODI players, A for Test specialists, BC for ODI and T20I cricketers, C for T20I players, and D for developing talent. Babar Azam and Salman Ali Agha are contracted for both Tests and ODIs, while no individual received a contract covering all three formats.

Aaqib clarified that these categories do not restrict players from joining franchise leagues or other formats, though Test-only athletes are encouraged to prioritize four-day cricket. He added that central contracts do not guarantee selection and that uncontracted players like Rizwan remain eligible for national duty. Financial compensation has been increased, featuring incentives like doubled match fees for victories against higher-ranked opponents. The development group features emerging first-class players such as Muhammad Ghazi Ghori and Saqib Khan, who recently competed in a Test series against Sri Lanka.

This restructuring matters as Pakistan aims to narrow its national selection pool to roughly 20 players through upcoming domestic competitions and multi-team matches. The board's new approach seeks to address previous shortfalls while integrating fresh talent into international cricket. Background details show that players had been without central contracts since the expiration of their previous agreements in June. Through these rigorous contractual obligations, which include fitness testing and domestic participation, the PCB hopes to foster long-term success across all international formats.

stories.title: Two Tanker Attacks Reported Near Oman's Khasab by UKMTO
stories.summary:
Two separate tanker attack incidents occurred near Khasab, Oman, on Saturday, according to the United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations (UKMTO). The first incident involved an outbound tanker in the Strait of Hormuz that was struck on its stern by an unidentified projectile approximately 11 nautical miles north of Khasab. Later, the UKMTO reported a second attack where a tanker was hit in its engine room by an unidentified projectile about 17 nautical miles east of Khasab.
